app_name: BIBLIA – Die Reise durch Gottes Wort
personality: 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal structure with 6 Glass/Luxe premium lighting and finish (Cozy Fantasy)
personality_one_liner: An immersive, warm, and highly tactile cozy fantasy experience blending hand-drawn parchment aesthetics with premium, glowing UI overlays.

spacing.rule: Generous, organic spacing that allows the UI to breathe. Avoid tight clustering; let elements feel softly placed on the page rather than rigidly locked into a grid.

do's: Use heavy glassmorphism with a warm `surfaceSecondary` tint underneath for floating map controls, bottom tabs, and pinned headers to keep the rich map visible.
Ensure text on glass uses `onSurface` and contrast is guaranteed by adjusting tint opacity.
dont's: Don't use glass on standard list items or cards inside the library; keep those solid parchment (`surfaceSecondary`).

screens.name: Weltkarte
screens.purpose: The core interactive hub featuring a large, zoomable fantasy map with interactive nodes and floating UI overlays.

states.loading: A warm fading logo against a solid parchment background.
states.empty: N/A - The map always has content.
states.error: A torn parchment style error card overlay.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map behind all UI. Floating, glassmorphic bottom tab bar. Top area contains a floating glass pill with player XP/Level on the left, and a settings/filter button on the right. Map POIs are rendered as custom interactive SVG nodes. Tap on a POI opens a `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` displaying the station details (using the station colors).

screens.name: Lernstation (7-Phase Flow)
screens.purpose: Guides the user through a sequence of study, reading, and quizzes.

states.loading: Centered loading spinner with 'Bereite Station vor...'
states.empty: Illustration of an open journal indicating no active tasks.
states.error: Torn page message with a 'Neu laden' button.

screens.layout: A stacked card or pager layout (react-native-reanimated). A sticky progress bar at the top (golden accent). Content area scrolls within a safe container. A sticky primary CTA ('Weiter' / 'Abschließen') at the bottom.

screens.name: Studienbibliothek
screens.purpose: A cozy, searchable archive of unlocked content, notes, and bookmarks.

states.loading: Skeleton rows shaped like journal entries.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty vintage notebook with text 'Deine Bibliothek ist noch leer.'
states.error: Error message styled as a faded ink blot.

screens.layout: A list of large, tactile cards. Top hero section features a cozy library image with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Cards use `surfaceSecondary` with `md` margin, layered over a `surface` background.

screens.name: Profil & Journal
screens.purpose: Shows the user's progress, XP, badges, and learning history.

states.empty: A faded map illustration encouraging the user to start a journey.
states.error: Standard error overlay with retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable dashboard. Top section: User's level and XP with a prominent, warm golden glow/gradient. Middle section: Grid of badges/achievements. Bottom section: List of recent journal entries (notes).

hero_map_background.alt: Close-up of an antiqued map highlighting in a warm sepia tone.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '8 Hand-Drawn / Journal' mixed with '6 Glass/Luxe' personality. The UI must feel warm, organic, and premium (Cozy Fantasy).
The primary interactive map must be full-bleed, using `react-native-svg` and `react-native-gesture-handler` for pinch-to-zoom and pan interactions.
Do NOT use pure white or solid blacks. The base surface is `#F9F3E8` (warm parchment), and ink text is `#2C2822`.
All text overlaid on images must use a 3-stop vertical `expo-linear-gradient` (transparent -> 20% surfaceInverse -> 70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text contrast.
Use heavy glassmorphism for floating overlays (like bottom tabs and map filter pills) to allow the map to show through with a rich blurred effect. Make sure to apply the `low_end_android_fallback`.
Implement the 7-phase learning flow as a smooth, animated pager or step sequence using `react-native-reanimated`.
Primary call-to-action buttons should be sticky at the bottom of scrolling forms/flows, avoiding the safe area notch.
Do not use default system alerts or plain blue standard iOS buttons. Style every component to fit the theme.
Incorporate the specified custom station colors (`stationEvent`, `stationNarrative`, etc.) into the map POI markers and bottom sheets.
